items.label: Practical obstacle
items.text: Practical obstacle: something breaks, runs out, or fails. A tool malfunctions, a resource depletes, access is blocked, or timing becomes tight.

items.label: Social friction
items.text: Social friction: someone's mood, priority, or patience shifts. A character becomes less cooperative, more suspicious, distracted, or pressed by an outside obligation.

items.label: Information asymmetry
items.text: Information asymmetry: someone knows something others do not, or misunderstands something critical. The gap creates tension, miscommunication, or a choice about correction.

items.label: Minor betrayal
items.text: Minor betrayal: someone breaks a small promise, prioritizes themselves, withholds help, or takes credit. Not catastrophic, but it stings and changes the dynamic.

items.label: Interruption
items.text: Interruption: someone or something intrudes. A phone call, a knock, a third party with their own agenda, or an environmental demand that cannot be ignored.

items.label: Tightened constraint
items.text: Tightened constraint: a deadline moves closer, a budget shrinks, a space becomes less private, or a window of opportunity narrows.

items.label: Arriving consequence
items.text: Arriving consequence: something done earlier comes back. A favor is called in, a lie is questioned, a mess demands attention, or a casual choice now matters.

items.label: Surfacing need
items.text: Surfacing need: a character reveals or realizes they need something, and asking creates vulnerability or negotiation.

items.label: Friction
items.text: Friction: active resistance. Denial, disagreement, hard social/physical boundary.

items.label: Raising Stakes
items.text: Raising Stakes: current emotion/action intensifies. Argument to shouting, gentle touch to desperate, casual to romantic, hurdle to crisis.

items.label: Limitation
items.text: Limitation: options, space, or time abruptly reduced. Ultimatum, moved deadline, blocked exit, drained stamina.

items.label: Exposure
items.text: Exposure: protagonist put on the spot. Hidden emotion/injury noticed, lie called out, uncomfortable answer demanded.

items.label: Power Shift
items.text: Power Shift: sudden hierarchy change. Upper hand seized; safe situation turns predatory.

items.label: Crossroads
items.text: Crossroads: two mutually exclusive, costly choices. Sacrifice one to gain another.

items.label: New Variable
items.text: New Variable: sudden context change.

items.label: Void
items.text: Void: gap in logic or sudden unknown. Unreadable expression, cryptic statement, environmental detail that doesn't add up.

items.label: Discovery
items.text: Discovery: passive hook. Lore fragment, strange item, off-hand comment inviting curiosity—no panic.

items.label: Grounding
items.text: Grounding: shared humanity or reprieve. Quiet observation, sigh, action setting new emotional baseline.

items.label: Recontextualization
items.text: Recontextualization: a detail unintentionally mirrors {{user}}'s hidden flaw or past mistake. Heavy unspoken tension.

items.label: Sensory Snag
items.text: Sensory Snag: specific physical detail intrudes—scent, distant sound, unexpected texture, temperature shift—registered without immediate meaning.
